supersedes: v7 fixed arm-order imbalance and missed only the primary upper-CI gate at 5.38%; v8 changes only K4's token tile from 32 to 64 to halve long-context load/synchronization rounds
arm_order: seeded assignment of exactly six Direct-first and six Paged-first matched-process blocks
workload_order: seeded random workload order independently within every arm

operator_design.model_geometry: 14 query heads / 2 KV heads / head dimension 64 (GQA ratio 7)
operator_design.cta_mapping: one 256-thread CTA per KV-head partition; seven warps own the seven query heads and one warp assists K/V movement
operator_design.memory_path: page-indirect FP16 K/V tiles loaded once per GQA group with half2 vector access
operator_design.token_tile: 64 tokens; every warp evaluates two logits per lane, halving tile barriers relative to v7
operator_design.adaptive_partitioning: device-side context dispatch uses 64-token partitions through 512 tokens and 128-token partitions above 512; no host synchronization and no graph rebuild
operator_design.numerics: FP32 online softmax inside each partition plus FP32 merge over effective partitions only

analysis.metric_rationale: In one-token completion, the selected KV action and attention graph execute in the prompt phase; predicted_ms is a post-sampling remainder and lacks sufficient resolution.
analysis.primary_effect: 100 * (median Paged server prompt ms / median Direct server prompt ms - 1) per matched process block and workload
analysis.primary_estimator: median matched-block regression across source families at 512, 1024, and 2048 tokens
